x: He won all but three races, losing only to Australian Garry Bentley (NCAA College Division champion from South Dakota State), Kenyan Mike Boit, and US Olympians Frank Shorter, Doug Brown and Jeff Galloway - these three in the AAU.
Second to fourth places were filled by Yifter and Kedir (Ethiopia) and Bayi (Tanzania) while that great 800/1,500 man Mike Boit (Kenya) was 35th.

There were also some former stars who were beginning to fade including those great sprinters Pietro Mennea and Allan Wells (third and fourth in the 200m), and John Walker (NZ) and Mike Boit (Kenya) - ninth and twelth in the 1500m.
